messages:
elena: shared a trimmed mock of the trace viewer. main asks: wording for export actions, sticky request id, and keyboard pagination. attaching PNG in thread.
harry: quick thought: distinguish "Copy trace" (clipboard of visible frames) vs "Download trace (JSON)". users expect explicit JSON label for files.
ashok: tracking: emit trace.copy.clipboard and trace.download.json. include trace_id, user_tier, model as props.
maya: accessibility notes: add role=region with aria-labelledby for the trace header, aria-labels for both export buttons, and aria-live on copy confirmation. ensure tooltips are keyboard accessible.
tim: keyboard: prev/next + page input works. avoid infinite scroll for keyboard users. add aria-current to active page. frame expands with Enter and announce via aria-live.
a11ybot: checklist: [x] aria-live copy confirmation [x] role=region for header [ ] focus ring contrast review [ ] tooltips keyboard focusable
elena: thanks — i'll update mock: primary inline "Copy trace" button, kebab for "Download trace (JSON)" + permalink, sticky id pill with copy, per-frame aria-expanded toggles, prev/next + page input. will post revised PNG and short keyboard demo later today. :thumbsup:
